anchor.guidance: Mgmt: Rs 4,000 Cr cumulative FY27+FY28; 35% op EBITDA; 25% PAT; end-FY27 book ~Rs 2,500 Cr

logic: Base 30% CAGR off depressed TTM; trails Rs 4,000 Cr FY27+28 guide — needs Rs 2,500 Cr end-book + DAC counter-UAS conversion.
Bear = tender drought persists + op margin stuck ~27% + derate to 35x. Bull = DAC thousands-Cr anti-drone + Rs 700-800 Cr simulator pipeline converts, P/E held at 68x.
Key insight: EPS spread 21.0 -> 96.7 (~4.6x) is smaller than price spread 733 -> 6575 (~9.0x) — the multiple does the heavy lifting.
Monitor quarterly: order inflow vs Rs 2,500 Cr target, Q2/Q3 execution (12-mo cycle), op margin vs 35%, debtor/inventory days, DAC tenders, treasury share of PBT.

meta.kicker: Anti-drone + combat-training simulators — debt-free, order-booked, richly priced
